```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```

```
public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ ensures (arr == null && \result == null) || 
    //@         (arr != null && \result != null && \result.length == arr.length &&
    //@          (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length;
    //@             (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]) &&
    //@             (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])) &&
    //@             (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && i > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]) ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]))
    //@          )
    //@         );
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j])) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && j > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]) ==> ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))
        //@ );
        //@ loop_writes i, wordStart, ret[*];
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }
```

```
public class CompareArray {
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;
        }
        if (a.length != b.length) {
            return false;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (a[i] != b[i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class CompareArray {
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (
    //@    (a == null && b == null) ||
    //@    (a != null && b != null &&
    //@     a.length == b.length &&
    //@     (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] == b[i]))
    //@  );
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;
        }
        if (a.length != b.length) {
            return false;
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; a[j] == b[j];
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases a.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (a[i] != b[i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
    //@ requires y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ requires (y > 0 ==> x <= Integer.MAX_VALUE - y) && (y < 0 ==> x >= Integer.MIN_VALUE - y);
    //@ requires (y < 0 ==> x >= Integer.MIN_VALUE - (-y));
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == x + y;
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
```

```java
//@ requires (y > 0 ==> x <= Integer.MAX_VALUE - y) && (y < 0 ==> x >= Integer.MIN_VALUE - y);
```

Since y<0, x >= Integer.MIN_VALUE - y is equivalent to x >= Integer.MIN_VALUE - y.

But in the loop, sum is decremented by 1 n times, where n = -y.

So sum = x - (y + n) is maintained, but y + n = y + (-y) = 0, so sum = x - 0 = x at start.

Wait, the loop invariant says sum == x - (y + n), but y + n = y + (-y) = 0, so sum == x - 0 == x.

But as n decreases, sum changes.

Anyway, the problem is that sum = sum - 1 can underflow.

To avoid that, we need to ensure that sum > Integer.MIN_VALUE before decrement.

But since sum is changing in the loop, we can't just add a precondition on x and y.

Hence, we can add loop invariants to ensure sum >= Integer.MIN_VALUE + 1 before decrement.

So adding loop invariants:

```java
//@ maintaining sum >= Integer.MIN_VALUE + 1;
```

inside the else branch's while loop.

Similarly, in the if branch, sum = sum + 1, so sum <= Integer.MAX_VALUE - 1 before increment.

Add:

```java
//@ maintaining sum <= Integer.MAX_VALUE - 1;
```

inside the if branch's while loop.

Thus, the refined code is:

```
public class Add {
    //@ requires y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ requires (y > 0 ==> x <= Integer.MAX_VALUE - y) && (y < 0 ==> x >= Integer.MIN_VALUE - y);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == x + y;
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x;
        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;
            //@ maintaining n >= 0;
            //@ maintaining sum == x + (y - n);
            //@ maintaining sum <= Integer.MAX_VALUE - 1;
            //@ decreases n;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum + 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int n = -y;
            //@ maintaining n >= 0;
            //@ maintaining sum == x - (y + n);
            //@ maintaining sum >= Integer.MIN_VALUE + 1;
            //@ decreases n;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum - 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        }
        return sum;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {

            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;

            ret[i] = a[i];
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Find {
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```
